communications-gateway-per-user-full-cyc.title: Per-user meters charge for the whole billing cycle
communications-gateway-per-user-full-cyc.body: This estimate bills subscribers above the 999 included. Microsoft says per-user meters charge for the entire billing cycle, so the bill follows the peak number of assigned numbers and is not prorated for part-month use.

citation.source: Azure Communications Gateway: plan and manage costs
citation.quote: Per-user meters charge for the entire billing cycle.

communications-gateway-lab-moved-users.title: Users moved between deployments count in both
communications-gateway-lab-moved-users.body: This estimate includes a lab deployment next to production. Microsoft says users moved between deployments count towards the meters in both deployments, so moving users to the lab raises the bill.

citation.source: Azure Communications Gateway: plan and manage costs
citation.quote: If you have multiple Azure Communications Gateway deployments and you move users between deployments, these users count towards meters in both deployments.
